title: Sakikkû (SA.GIG), Babylonian Diagnostic Handbook of Esagil-kīn-apli / Вавилонский диагностический справочник «Сакикку»
author: Esagil-kīn-apli (redactor)
date: Redacted 11th c. BCE; manuscripts 7th–3rd c. BCE
edition: Labat, Traité akkadien de diagnostics et pronostics médicaux (1951); later Heeßel (2000) and Scurlock (2014), not re-verified.
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka 'Сакикку': 0 results; no ru.wikipedia article or translation found.
en_evidence: Scurlock 2014 (not re-verified online); en.wikipedia confirms the structure but gives no bibliography.
value: The first systematic diagnostic manual. Comparanda for the Hippocratic Prognostic and Epidemics; central to history of medicine and Greco-Babylonian contacts.
ai_feasibility: high-medium: formulaic entries, but disease identifications are contested, which suits structured debate between models.
pilot_unit: Tablets 1–2 (signs met on the way to the patient)
